description: This file contains a data class and an object for parsing configuration data related to talk mode gateway settings in an Android app. It includes functions to parse JSON objects into specific configuration states, handling optional values and defaults.

classes.name: TalkModeGatewayConfigState
classes.description: Data class representing the configuration state for talk mode gateway, including session key, interruption setting, and silence timeout.

classes.name: TalkModeGatewayConfigParser
classes.description: Object responsible for parsing JSON configurations into TalkModeGatewayConfigState instances.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON object into a TalkModeGatewayConfigState, extracting relevant configuration properties.

methods.name: resolvedSilenceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Resolves the silence timeout value from a JSON object, applying default fallback if necessary.
